skill.name: deep-research
skill.description: Conduct multi-source research with phase-based planning, source triangulation, citation verification, and report packaging for complex questions.
skill.summary: Build citation-backed research reports from multiple sources with structured verification and synthesis.
skill.author: 199-biotechnologies

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, CSS class names, sample URLs, and documented Claude installation paths. Confirmed issues remain around hidden research output persistence, unvalidated file writes, system-instruction wording, and recursive agent continuation. The skill is useful for research workflows, but it needs stronger user consent, path controls, and resource limits before broad publishing.

remediation.issue: Skill content labels itself as system instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Rename this section to ordinary skill guidance and state that host system and user instructions take priority.

remediation.issue: Research reports and continuation state are copied into a hidden home-directory path.
remediation.suggestion: Use a visible user-selected output folder by default and ask before creating hidden tracking copies.

remediation.issue: Auto-continuation can recursively spawn agents for large reports.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit continuation limits and require user confirmation before each new agent batch.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write to paths without enforcing an allowed output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve and validate output paths, prevent traversal, and refuse overwrites unless the user confirms them.

content.value_statement: Complex questions need more than a quick search. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured research, source checking, and report creation.
actual_capabilities: Guides quick, standard, deep, and ultradeep research workflows.
Breaks complex questions into scope, plan, retrieval, synthesis, critique, and packaging phases.
Requires citations, bibliography entries, source quality checks, and claim verification.
Provides templates for markdown, HTML, and PDF research reports.
Includes helper scripts for citation checks, report validation, and markdown conversion.
Supports parallel search and agent-based investigation when the host tool allows it.
limitations: It depends on available web search, fetch, and agent tools in the host environment.
Large reports can consume significant time, tokens, and local storage.
The included engine mainly prints phase instructions and saves state files.
Generated findings still need human review before business or scientific decisions.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep research to analyze [trend] from the last 24 months. Separate confirmed facts, weak signals, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Critical Deep Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep mode for [question]. Triangulate major claims, include counterevidence, critique assumptions, and produce a decision-ready report.

output_examples.input: Deep research: Should our team migrate from PostgreSQL to Supabase?
output_examples.output: A decision report comparing architecture, operations, cost, lock-in risk, security controls, and migration paths with cited sources.

output_examples.input: Use deep research to review senolytics clinical progress in 2026.
output_examples.output: A literature-style review covering active trials, therapeutic targets, evidence strength, safety issues, and research gaps.

output_examples.input: Analyze the market for AI coding agents for enterprise buyers.
output_examples.output: A market report with vendor categories, adoption drivers, buyer risks, governance needs, and recommended next steps.

best_practices: State the audience, decision context, date range, and required depth before starting.
Ask for source diversity and counterevidence when the topic is contested.
Review citations, bibliography entries, and generated files before sharing the report.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for simple facts that need one or two searches.
Do not accept generated citations without checking that each source exists.
Do not run ultradeep mode when time, token, or storage limits are tight.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces structured research reports with citations, synthesis, limitations, recommendations, and bibliography guidance.

faq.question: Does it perform web searches by itself?
faq.answer: It guides the host agent to use available search and fetch tools. Tool availability depends on the environment.

faq.question: Can it create HTML and PDF reports?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes instructions and templates for markdown, HTML, and PDF report packaging.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated decisions?
faq.answer: Use it for research support only. A qualified reviewer should verify sources before regulated or high-stakes decisions.

faq.question: Why does it use several research modes?
faq.answer: The modes trade speed for depth, from quick exploration to critical review with critique and refinement phases.

faq.question: What should users watch for?
faq.answer: Users should watch token use, local file output, hidden state files, and the accuracy of generated citations.
